name: NPM-TT2
tagline: Up to 40 trays and 92 inputs for high-mix production

intro.text: The Panasonic NPM-TT2 is a twin-tray modular SMT platform for any production mix. Dual-lane operation can build more of one product or two different products at once, with a lightweight 3-nozzle head V2 (100 N), optional pin-in-place lighting and stackable stick feeders.

items: Parts from 01005 (0402) up to 120 × 90 × 28 mm; BGAs up to 80 × 80 mm
Up to 40 trays plus 26 fixed tape inputs per side, 92 inputs in total
Feeders and nozzles compatible with CM and NPM series
